svg.title: Sod shock tube from verified WebAssembly
svg.desc: Five state profiles at time0.2 and grid refinement against exact Riemann conservative cell averages. Rendering and scientific comparison are host calculations.

g.text: A shock tube, step by checked step
Stationary Sod · 100 cells · t = 0.2 · 93 accepted Rusanov steps · gamma = 1.4
Exact-byte execution + accepted-state safety are proved. Riemann comparison and refinement are numerical validation.
First-order finite volume · transmissive boundaries · no reconstruction · data/euler-sod-v1
